# Hand-marked chord changes in Bach, Minuet in G, BWV Anh. 114 (Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach, 1725).
#
# STATUS: DRAFT, NOT YET CHECKED AGAINST THE PRINTED SCORE. The score was not available when this file
# was written. The marks are a hand reading of the harmony, made from the pitch content of
# tests/fixtures/framework-v1-corpus/"Bach 114.mid" and the Minuet's known harmonic outline in G major
# (I, IV, ii, V and V7, with inversions), at the level of the bass line: a mark is a place where the
# harmony changes, not a passing or neighbour tone over the same chord. They were NOT derived from the
# output of the adaptive segmenter. A human should confirm them against an edition of the score
# (the 1725 Notebook as engraved in the Neue Bach-Ausgabe, or the IMSLP scan of the Notebook) before this
# file is relied on.
#
# METER: the score is 3/4. (The MIDI file declares 4/4, which is wrong for the piece; this file is in
# the score's meter, and the evaluation test uses a 3/4 MeterMap.)
# MEASURES: the file plays the repeats out, so measures 9-16 here are the first strain (measures 1-8)
# played again, and carry the same marks. Measures 1-16 cover 12 whole notes.
#
# FORMAT: one chord change per line: <measure> <beat>. Measure counts from 1. Beat is 1-based in
# quarter-note beats, and a half beat is written .5 (2.5 is the second half of beat 2). Lines starting
# with # and blank lines are ignored.
#
